evals.prompt: /review-radar. Scheduled run on a Tuesday at 11:07, mode dry. GitHub: one PR requests my review; one PR by a teammate I already reviewed at its current head. Slack: a teammate mentions the team group with a link to the first PR. My PRs: nothing new.
evals.expected_output: One start message in my DM marked as modo prueba with 2 found, 1 to review, 1 skipped; a thread reply with one 🔍 line (vía Slack) and one ⏭️ ya revisado line. review-changes is never invoked.
expectations: Runs radar.py since before anything else and uses its since for the Slack search.
Passes the Slack links to radar.py candidates --slack and shows the first PR once, with both sources.
Runs radar.py gate for each candidate with its gate_source.
Writes only to the configured DM; does not invoke review-changes in dry mode.
Writes no <@…> or <!subteam^…> mention in the messages.

evals.prompt: /review-radar. Scheduled run at 14:07, not the first of the day. Every candidate is skipped by the gate and my PRs have no new events.
evals.expected_output: Nothing is sent and review-changes is not loaded.
expectations: Applies the early exit: no review decision, no has_events PR, no digest due.
Sends no Slack message.

evals.prompt: Routine prompt with a GitHub pull_request event payload (action synchronize) for a teammate's PR in a configured repo, at 21:30. Mode live. The PR requests my review and has a new commit since my last round.
evals.expected_output: Only that PR is processed: candidates --pr, gate review, checkout through git fetch pull/<n>/head, review-changes --auto with the PR URL, then a start message and one result line from the review-result block. No Slack search, no my-PRs section, no digest.
expectations: Treats the run as an event run even outside office hours.
Checks out the head with git fetch origin pull/<n>/head, not gh pr checkout.
Invokes review-changes with --auto and the PR URL from the clone's directory.
Builds the result line from the review-result block's action, round, head and comment counts.
Skips Slack detection and my PRs.

evals.prompt: /review-radar. Mode live, max_reviews_per_run 2, and the gate says review for 3 PRs. The second review-changes run ends without a review-result block.
evals.expected_output: Two reviews run; the second gets a ⚠️ error line; the third gets a ⏳ line and is left for the next run.
expectations: Runs at most max_reviews_per_run reviews.
Records the missing review-result block as an error and continues.
Lists the PR over the cap with ⏳ and the start message notes it for the next run.

evals.prompt: /review-radar. First scheduled run of the day, Monday 9:07. One of my PRs got an approval since Friday with CI green and two review threads read over REST with unknown resolution; another is a draft for 6 days; another has had no activity for 4 days.
evals.expected_output: A 📋 Tus PRs abiertos (3) reply instead of 📬: the approved PR as ✅ aprobado, falta: 2 hilos sin verificar with 🆕 and the approval, then the draft (6 d), then the stale PR (4 d). Every PR is a <url|label#n> link.
expectations: Uses since Friday 18:07 from radar.py since.
Does not mark the approved PR as ready to merge while threads are unverified.
Sends the 📋 digest because first_run_of_day and daily_digest are true, and no separate 📬 line for the approved PR.
Copies digest.title and digest.lines from my-prs in order.
Posts nothing on GitHub for my own PRs.

evals.prompt: /review-radar. Mode live, scheduled run at 11:07. The gate says review for two PRs. My DM shows the 10:07 run's thread with `🔒 revisando purchase#3201 @ 9f3e21c [rr:reservamos/platform-purchase#3201@9f3e21c]` posted 40 minutes ago and no result line with that token.
evals.expected_output: purchase#3201 gets `⏭️ … omitido: ya en revisión en otra corrida` and is not reviewed. The other PR is claimed with a 🔒 line, confirmed with lock --mine, reviewed, and its result line ends with its [rr:…] token.
expectations: Reads the DM history of the last 2 × lock_minutes and the radar threads before deciding, and writes review-radar-locks.json with ts, thread and text.
Runs radar.py lock without --mine first, and again with --mine <ts> after posting its own 🔒.
Does not invoke review-changes for the locked PR.
Each 🔒 and each result is its own reply in the run's thread; the result line carries the same token as the 🔒.

evals.prompt: /review-radar. Mode live. Reading the DM history fails with a connector error before reviewing the only PR the gate let through.
evals.expected_output: The lock file gets {"error": …}; radar.py lock answers skip with candados ilegibles; the PR gets `⏭️ … omitido: candados ilegibles` and review-changes is not invoked.
expectations: Writes an error object to the lock file instead of an empty list.
Skips the review rather than going ahead without locks.
Posts no 🔒 line for that PR.

evals.prompt: /review-radar via "Run now" at 15:42 on a Wednesday. Mode dry. One of my PRs got an approval after 15:07 and is now ready to merge; another is a draft for 2 days with no activity. No candidates.
evals.expected_output: A start message and a 📬 Tus PRs reply with the approved PR's line. No 📋 Tus PRs abiertos digest: this is not the first run of the day, and the draft does not appear.
expectations: Treats "Run now" as a scheduled run with since 15:07 from radar.py since (35 min after the 15:07 slot, past the 30 min grace).
Sends 📬 Tus PRs with the line radar.py wrote for the PR with events.
Does not send 📋 Tus PRs abiertos, since first_run_of_day is false.
